judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage` with `sessions` field) instead of the explicitly specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, and `ConversationSummary`. It directly violates core design decisions and acceptance criteria: it omits the `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag entirely (serving lists by default), returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) instead of `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` when a store lacks `listFor`, and allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation instead of restricting `limit` to integers 1–200. Furthermore, it logs `error.message` on store failure (which the spec/issue prohibits to avoid leaking driver connection strings), omits `StoreCannotList`, fails to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository.
